lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, primarily organized into five visible longitudinal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure most visible in the mid-to-posterior region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal linear feature running horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-reflecting superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical high-intensity linear mark located immediately posterior to the branchial region; an elongated high-luminance object is attached to the dorsal ridge, likely a symbiotic or parasitic organism.
